Stock market news | Revenue up 3.8% to ₹3,390.9 crore; Loss ₹137 crore

Reliance Brands reported FY26 revenue of Rs 3,390.9 crore, up 3.8%, and a narrowed loss of Rs 137 crore. The figures show improved financial performance for the fiscal year.
The company runs more than 1,085 Points of Sale across India and works with over 90 partner brands, highlighting its expanding retail footprint in the fashion and lifestyle sector.
